description: Image, illustration, icon and logo fitting/cropping pass across the whole site - the user's top priority ('most importantly, make sure every visual element is properly fitted and positioned'). This reconciles the single most important idea from origin/test (service illustrations use object-fit: contain, not cover, because they carry built-in whitespace and cover crops/zooms them oddly) and extends that fitting discipline to every image, icon, and logo in main. This is one coherent unit of work: it only touches image presentation and the elements that frame images. Do NOT change any copy, data, section, or component structure. Do NOT hand-edit src/assets/images.ts.
steps: PINNED SERVICES VISUAL (src/styles.css `.pinned-services-visual` + `.pinned-services-visual img`, ~line 738-755, and its @media(max-width:900px) block ~line 796): the four service illustrations are wide/short with built-in whitespace (service-ai 937x400, service-web 422x400, service-commerce 512x400, service-cloud 1114x424). Change `.pinned-services-visual img` from `object-fit: cover` to `object-fit: contain` with `object-position: center` and add inset padding (e.g. inset ~6-8% via padding on the frame or `inset`/`width/height` like the test reference `inset:7%; width:86%; height:86%`) so no illustration is cropped or edge-clipped. Keep the frame's gradient background (var(--lavender)->var(--sky)) and border-radius so contained illustrations sit on a branded panel rather than bare. Give the sticky visual a sensible height cap on desktop (test used `height: min(60vh, 520px)`) but keep it consistent with main's existing sticky-chapter box height so it does not overflow the overflow:hidden `.stack-chapter`. Preserve the 'no CSS transition on img' comment/behavior (JS drives opacity every frame). In the <=900px block keep the static first-image visual but ensure contain fitting there too (no crop on the 14rem-tall mobile panel).

SERVICES DETAILED CARDS visual (src/styles.css `.service-live-visual img` ~line 1235 already `object-fit: contain` - verify it stays contain and that `.service-card-top` height (6.8rem grid / 9rem detailed) does not vertically clip the contained wide illustrations; if a wide illustration letterboxes with too much empty band, tighten the frame height or add object-position so it reads centered rather than floating). Do not remove the orbit/scan decorative layers.

PROJECTS EDITORIAL GRID (src/styles.css `.project-showcase-card img` ~line 972): images are absolutely positioned at top:-8%, height:116%, object-fit:cover for the parallax drift. Project images have varied intrinsic ratios (e.g. project-investigation 1240x697 wide, project-marketplace 1240x1240 square, project-luxury 948x950 square). Confirm object-position keeps the meaningful part of each in frame across both the span-2 (large) and span-1 (small) tiles; set `object-position: center top` or `center` so UI screenshots are not beheaded, and verify the 116% height + parallax top range never exposes a gap at the tile edges (the -8%..+? drift must always keep the image covering the tile). Keep the dark gradient caption overlay.

HOMEPAGE PROJECTS TEASER (src/styles.css `.project-image` ~line 943 aspect-ratio 16/10 + `.project-image img` object-fit cover): verify the 4 teaser cards crop consistently; add `object-position: center top` if screenshots get cropped at an awkward point. Keep hover scale.

FOUNDER STORY portrait (src/styles.css `.founder-story > img` ~line 1473, founder.webp 895x980 portrait, object-fit cover object-position top): verify it is not stretched and the face/top is retained at all widths incl the <=600px `min-height:17rem;max-height:22rem` block. Keep object-position top.

ABOUT SPLIT image (src/styles.css `.about-split > img` ~line 1531, about.webp 533x403): it has no explicit aspect-ratio and relies on intrinsic size; ensure it aligns to the text column height without distortion - add a sensible `aspect-ratio` or `object-fit: cover` with a max-height if it looks unbalanced next to the copy, but do NOT distort it. Keep the mint background fallback.

TECH MARQUEE LOGOS (src/styles.css `.tech-band img` ~line 1391 width/height 3rem object-fit contain; logos are 148x148 square PNG/webp): confirm all 8 render at a consistent visual weight; if any logo looks oversized/undersized due to internal padding differences, normalize with consistent box + object-fit contain + padding rather than changing the asset. Keep the mask-faded edges and marquee animation.

FOOTER CTA background image (src/styles.css `.footer-cta img` ~line 1839, footer.png 1344x420, object-fit cover opacity .18 screen blend): verify it does not tile/stretch oddly at very wide or very narrow widths; keep it decorative.

HEADER + BRAND LOGOS (src/styles.css `.header-logo img` ~line 368 and `.site-brand .brand-mark` ~line 383): demaze-logo.png is 1344x420 (wordmark) and demaze-logo-mark.png is 373x420 (mark). Confirm both are constrained by height with width:auto so neither is stretched; verify the footer brand mark and header wordmark keep aspect ratio. Do not swap assets.

Run a final self-review that every /background-image rule in styles.css either uses object-fit contain (logos/illustrations with whitespace) or object-fit cover with a deliberate object-position (photographic/screenshot fills), and that nothing can overflow its container or expose a gap.
acceptance_criteria: `.pinned-services-visual img` uses object-fit: contain (not cover) with centered positioning and inset padding so service illustrations are never cropped or edge-clipped, on both desktop sticky panel and the <=900px static panel.
Every project/service/founder/about/tech/logo image rule in src/styles.css has an intentional object-fit and, where cover is used, an object-position that keeps the meaningful subject in frame.
No image rule can overflow its container or expose an uncovered gap (parallax drift ranges stay within the 116%/inset budget).
No copy, data, section, component structure, or asset file is changed; src/assets/images.ts is untouched.
src/styles.css remains valid CSS (balanced braces, no empty property values).
verification: Deferred to CI (sandbox cannot run): `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build` must succeed (Tailwind/Vite will fail the build on malformed CSS).
Run `git diff --stat` and confirm only src/styles.css (and possibly image-framing-only component class usage) changed, with no edits to site-data.ts or images.ts.
Grep confirm no `object-fit: cover` remains on `.pinned-services-visual img` and no bare `content: ;` remains: `grep -nE "object-fit|content:\s*;" src/styles.css`.
findings: All image-presentation changes made in src/styles.css only; site-data.ts and images.ts untouched. Changes: (1) .pinned-services-visual img switched from object-fit:cover to object-fit:contain + object-position:center + symmetric inset:7%/width:86%/height:86% so the four wide/short whitespace-bearing service illustrations (937x400,422x400,512x400,1114x424) sit whole and centered on the lavender->sky gradient panel; the same selector covers the <=900px static 14rem panel so no crop there either; the 'no CSS transition on img' comment/behavior preserved. (2) .project-image img (homepage 16/10 teaser cover) gained object-position:center top so screenshots crop from the top, not beheaded at center; hover scale kept. (3) .project-showcase-card img (editorial parallax cover, top:-8%/height:116%) gained object-position:center top; verified the JS drift range (top = -8 + (p-0.5)*10 => -13%..-3%) with 116% height always covers the tile (edge buffers 3%..13%), so no gap is ever exposed; dark caption overlay kept. (4) .tech-band img (already contain) gained object-position:center + padding:0.15rem to normalize the 8 square 148x148 logos' visual weight despite differing internal padding; marquee/mask kept. (5) .about-split > img (about.webp 533x403, previously no aspect-ratio) pinned to aspect-ratio:4/3 + height:auto + object-fit:cover + object-position:center so it balances the copy column without distortion; mint bg kept. (6) .footer-cta img (footer.png 1344x420 decorative wash) gained object-position:center so the wide cover crop is deliberate and never stretches/tiles. Verified/left as-is (already correct): .service-live-visual img (contain), .founder-story > img (cover + object-position:top, portrait, incl <=600px min/max-height block), .hero-visual video (contain, 16/9 no letterbox), header .header-logo img + .site-brand .brand-mark (height + width:auto, no stretch). Also fixed invalid CSS blocking the build: the empty `content: ;` on .industry-grid li:not(:last-child)::after (defect #1 in findings.md) replaced with a real middot content:"\00B7" + margin-left:0.3rem + muted color. Verification deferred to CI (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry unreachable, cannot run build/test locally); correctness checks done in-sandbox: braces balanced 398/398, no bare `content:;` remains, no `object-fit: cover` remains on .pinned-services-visual img, no line exceeds prettier printWidth 100, git diff --stat shows only src/styles.css (+ this feature file).
